item.title: GST Audit Handbook: Understanding Core GST Concepts, ITC, Returns, Exports, and Audit Checkpoints
item.description:
GST Audit Handbook: Understanding Core GST Concepts, ITC, Returns, Exports, and Audit Checkpoints

Goods and Services Tax (GST) transformed India’s indirect tax system by replacing multiple indirect taxes with a unified tax structure. While GST simplified taxation in many ways, it also introduced extensive compliance requirements. A GST audit is not merely a verification of tax payments. It is a comprehensive examination of transactions, accounting records, returns, and statutory compliance to ensure that the correct tax has been paid and all benefits claimed are legally admissible.

item.title: Building an Excel-Based GST Revenue Leakage Audit Tool for the Cement Industry
item.description:
Auditing a manufacturing firm—especially one operating in the heavy-material sector like cement—requires meticulous data cross-verification. In the cement industry, high-volume dispatches, bulk logistics via road and rail, uniform HSN codes, and complex input tax credit (ITC) chains make it a prime environment for potential revenue leakages.

To bridge the gap between raw financial records and statutory returns, auditors need a robust, centralized mechanism. This guide consolidates a complete blueprint for building a customized, Excel-based GST Revenue Leakage Analysis Tool tailored specifically for a cement manufacturing and trading firm.
